title: Variables and Data Types
description: Understanding variables and data types in Python

dataList.data: Variables are containers for storing data values. Python has various data types including integers, floats, strings, booleans, and more. Python is dynamically typed, meaning you don't need to declare the type of a variable explicitly.

# Variable assignment
name = 'John'
age = 25
height = 5.9
is_student = True

print(name, age, height, is_student)

data: set: Unordered collection of unique items
